name: Crush
summary: Add an openai-compat provider pointing at Diffusion Router.
statusNote: Configure this client manually using the steps below.
prerequisites: A Diffusion Router API key from API keys.

setup.title: Merge the Diffusion provider
setup.body: Preserve existing providers and your default model; this block is additive.

setup.title: Export your Diffusion key
setup.body: Add the export to your shell profile and open a new terminal.

restart: Restart Crush or start a new session so the merged configuration is read.

verification.title: Select the Diffusion model
verification.body: Press Ctrl+L or run the model picker and choose the Diffusion entry.

troubleshooting: 401/403: check the key and tenant binding in API keys.
Model missing from the picker: confirm the models array merged and the id matches the Connect catalog exactly.

removal.title: Remove the Diffusion provider
removal.body: Delete the providers.diffusion block and unset the key. Revoke the key in API keys if unused.

rollback: Restart Crush; your previous default provider is untouched.
